'''Lant''' was the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Lant system/Legends|Lant system]], a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Periphery/Legends|Periphery]], a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Lant was a trade world with extensive [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] holdings.<ref>''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
